r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: unbound confirm(target) confirms re-issued publications on late callbacks
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: late_confirm events on held-out D4 runs
r9FinalHypotheses.result: package 16/35 late callbacks confirmed via an expired publication (7/10 runs); bound 0
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: H04 requires that old callbacks can only release resources and never confirm a new context; the package violation is the H04 answer

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: cross-target coupling of liveness and of speculation credit is not in QUESTIONS
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: any shared resource across targets (joint commit window, global credit) lets one bad target starve the others; per-target isolation + refund restores progress
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: joint vs per-target commit under churn; global vs isolated vs refund credit in Sim
r9FinalHypotheses.result: joint 0/8 vs per-target 8/8; global credit G gets 1 of 6; refund_isolated G latency 5-9 vs 59-76
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: H06 asks to avoid permanent rejection by cross-target guards (joint transaction starvation); J06 asks for a hotspot starving others; both counterexamples are the questions themselves

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: complementarity of value reuse and re-sign migration depends on rebind kind
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: fresh (knowledge-losing) rebinds favour value reuse; carry rebinds favour migration; interaction sign flips
r9FinalHypotheses.result: fresh steps I=-503, carry I=0; adm 205->55 only fresh
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: interaction sign of value reuse x re-sign depending on rebind kind is a result inside X22

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: revive after cooperative exit decision is a phantom completion
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: revive is only safe before the exit decision; an exiting instance must count as wasted
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: regression test with cancel at 3, re-request at 4, phase 5
r9FinalHypotheses.result: fixed simulator: revives 0, restart latency >=30
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: phantom completion after cooperative exit is the late-result/in-place promotion race J02 names

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: phase split value is a load effect, not a per-job effect
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: split improves needed-job latency iff p<1 and pipeline overloaded (rho_joint>1)
r9FinalHypotheses.result: gate matches all 72 configs (tested 0.75 / >=1.25)
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: I04 asks for the phase diagram of split vs joint service; load-dependent split value is that diagram

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: reservation and speculation are antagonistic for short speculative work
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: with accurate multi-step prefetch, a reserved slot removes useful prefetch without lowering required max
r9FinalHypotheses.result: forward I=+96 (fixed), +57 (dyn5); required max unchanged
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: antagonism of reservation and speculation is the X23 interaction result

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: S04 asks for tunable locality; this states that restart-based rules cannot provide it at all
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: restarting the frozen scan at absolute or anchored boundaries leaves the influence radius unbounded on phase chains
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: edit radius of seg8/seg16/anchor on a 96-item decreasing chain
r9FinalHypotheses.result: radius 94/31/95 vs reference 92; forced cuts give 6/14
r9FinalHypotheses.decision: drop restart rules; only forced cuts bound locality (with pair loss)
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: S04 compares fixed-radius segmentation with bounded-influence rules; restart rules not bounding influence is its negative answer

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: T05 asks for a bound; this predicts WHERE residual gain lives
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: remaining physical-work savings concentrate in families with shared unknown variables (all ranks missing / phase chains), not in random partial knowledge
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: incumbent vs exact-q0 vs oracle_min on W06/W01/RP/W05 (n=10-12)
r9FinalHypotheses.decision: direct F-family effort to ambiguity-heavy workloads only
r9FinalHypotheses.fix_reason: predicts where residual gain lives (shared-variable families) inside T05

r9FinalHypotheses.difference_from_questions: not a listed question: exact typed support makes certificates refinement-intolerant
r9FinalHypotheses.prediction: a strong publication expires when an unknown fact in its support becomes known even if the canonical unit is unchanged; a refresh from L0 restores it
r9FinalHypotheses.minimal_experiment: tests/test_wpT.py::test_P6 (W01 chain, admit the true rank of a hole)
r9FinalHypotheses.result: publication expires; L0 now certifies the same unit; WP-A shadow refresh keeps current publications >= incumbent
